en.title: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students (Maharashtra)
en.benefit: Maintenance allowance (Rs 250 to Rs 700 a month; Rs 400 to Rs 1,350 for hostel students) plus tuition, exam and other approved fees.
en.how_to_apply: Fill the online form on mahadbtmahait.gov.in; contact your college or the district Assistant Commissioner of Social Welfare.
